task.title: M1: Adapter registry
task.description:
Build the adapter registry that is the first extensibility seam in docs/design.md. An adapter exposes detect(root): boolean and analyze(root, ctx): Promise<Partial<Snapshot>>. The registry runs every adapter whose detect matches, awaits all of them, and merges their partial results with the core merge so that polyglot repositories work from day one. Context carries the resolved ref, history window, and a logger.

Acceptance criteria:
- registerAdapter / runAdapters(root, ctx) are exported from packages/analyzers.
- All matching adapters run (concurrently where safe) and their results are merged via core mergeSnapshots.
- An adapter that throws fails loudly with the adapter name in the error; it does not silently drop its section.
- A repo matching no adapter yields a snapshot with empty files/functions/modules/edges and a warning.
- Tests use two fake adapters that each return a partial for the same file and assert the merged record and languages map.
